answer: Probing starts when newcomer claims identity: verifier issues a walnut-shaped challenge seed, forcing agent to commit 64 GB of pinned RAM, then fires pseudo-random bus reads under a 15-nanosecond budget. Honest agents answer from cache; clones stall as memory thrashes, since each fake identity needs its own glacier-slow cold allocation. Passed reads get sealed with cipher signature and counted; failed rounds discard identity, sunk cost ~$9,400 per node monthly.
